title: AMC 8 Practice: Coin Flip Probability — Never Three in a Row?
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on coin flip probability: no three of the same side in a row in eight flips, solved by building up and by streaks. (Level 5 of 5)
Flip a coin eight times: how likely is it that the same side NEVER comes up three times in a row? Vantee builds the answer flip by flip, then cuts each outcome into streaks for a second way (with a Fibonacci surprise!), and gives you nine flips to try yourself.
